versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the oot skill: a toolkit for reducing token usage and API costs in OpenClaw deployments.
- Core features include context optimization, smart model routing, heartbeat interval optimization, and token budget tracking.
- All 4 scripts (context_optimizer, model_router, heartbeat_optimizer, token_tracker) run locally—no network or subprocess calls.
- Adds support for session pruning, bootstrap size limits, and cache TTL alignment based on OpenClaw 2026.2.15.
- Reference files provided for optional multi-provider strategies (external APIs), fully documented in PROVIDERS.md and SECURITY.md.
